_comment: CHURN CARD — slip-aware eq34 election, 10-EPOCH WIRING SMOKE.  One functional key over
WHAT THIS CAN AND CANNOT SHOW.  It proves the seam runs on real data without losing tree
rank or crashing, and that the de-seed / re-admit counters populate.  It CANNOT grade the
policy: 10 cold epochs contain few slips, and the number that matters is the ratio
eq34_slip_readmitted / eq34_slip_deseeded over a leg with real slip traffic — near 1 means
the observation graph, not the election, is the binding constraint and the knob buys
little.  That field arm is still owed.
